name: Geo Targetly Geo Javascript
author: geotargetly

sections.description:
[https://youtu.be/g5o9zx6RBOA]

Geo JavaScript enables running a JavaScript code on your website based on a visitor’s country, state, or city. This provides the capability to execute different tools such as tracking scripts, forms, and popups based on visitor geolocation.

If you’re using form, a lead capture tool, or a popup that displays visitor location, you can wrap these scripts with Geo JavaScript, ensuring that they’re only seen by visitors from selected locations. Similarly, if you have customized JavaScript that you need to execute in particular locations, you can simply drop your code into our tool.

All it takes is pasting our tracking code to your website, which can be done in 5 minutes!

Don’t know where to start? Check out our video tutorial.

For step by step guidance, check out: GeoJavascript Quick Start Guide

And for help with tracking code implementation, check out our integration guide playlist on youtube.

A service by Geo Targetly.
– Paid account is required – see pricing
– 14-day free trial – no credit card needed

Features

  • Run JavaScript code based on visitor’s country, state or city
  • Customize scripts for tracking, forms, and popups
  • Light-weight tracking code for your website
  • Built-in analytics to keep tabs on every execution

Detailed docs can be found below

  • Overview https://geotargetly.com/geo-javascript
  • Quick Start Guide https://help.geotargetly.com/en/articles/1953343-geo-javascript-quick-start-guide
  • Docs https://help.geotargetly.com/en/collections/738705-geo-javascript

Support

  • Live chat at Geo Targetly

External services

This plugin connects to an external endpoint via the domain https://g594253006.co to load and run a script that powers its core
functionality, as outlined previously in the description.

It sends the user’s location each time the plugin is loaded. This is necessary to determine and customize the plugin’s
behavior based on the user’s geographical context.

This service is provided by Geo Targetly – Terms of Use,
Privacy Policy.
